says: A person binds this device's key and the checkout and registers the repository's decisions source. They select records 12 to 18 of one session transcript for local processing and this repository only; the owner reads that span (source.observe) and the packaged local adapter captures a memory entry from it as a draft at the head the source's registration committed (source.capture.record). The person stores a candidate choice from that capture (memory.candidate.store): version 1 names the capture and the exact span bytes as its origin. They edit the proposed synchronous mode under the same candidate id: version 2 keeps the origin of version 1. They then reject the candidate (memory.candidate.reject): the owner answers rejected with the candidate stored and no receipt, and writes version 3 standing rejected, still naming the same capture and bytes. Reading the candidate back (memory.candidate.read) returns all three versions, so both compared versions, the original and the edited proposal, stay readable beside the rejection, each with its origin. Nothing reached the destination: no step names a destination receipt or returns a choice_record or lifecycle_event, and the current state of the concern, resolved afterwards over the repository (memory.state.resolve), has no entry and reads the decisions source only at the head its registration committed.
